# Known-flaky tests. When a CI test step's only failures are tests listed
# here, .github/scripts/citest runs exactly those once more, and the job
# summary names each with its first failure's message. Anything else fails
# at once.
#
# One per line: the test (or Test/subtest), then its issue. An entry is
# there to be fixed: remove it with the fix.

TestRunWatchAutoLink https://github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/issues/245
